messages:
alex: Heads up — want to lock the launch acceptance rubric for Dedicated + Private GA. Key buckets: SLA targets, docs, support runbook, monitoring SLOs, pricing page + committed tiers. Can we agree on owners and must-haves by EOD Thursday?
maria: @alex I can own docs + public pricing copy. I'll need the final SLAs to write wording. Any hard limits on latency P95 we commit to?
jasper: From infra perspective: P95 latency target for text gen should be <= 150ms for hosted standard plan; Dedicated we can promise <120ms with reserved capacity. Need validation tests (seq lengths, batch sizes).
shannon: Support readiness: playbooks + oncall escalation flows needed. I want a checklist: who does handoff to support, training doc, runbook link.
kyla: @shannon I'll run a 1-hour walkthrough session. Also we need error budget guidance for automatic fallback policies.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled load test for dedicated-cluster on Thu 02:00 UTC. Results will post here.
alex: Great. Action items: docs -> @maria, SLA numbers -> @jasper to confirm by Wed, support playbook -> @shannon, monitoring SLOs + alerts -> @kyla. Also need pricing tiers: @maria to draft baseline with usage rates + reserved discounts.
jasper: Confirming I'll run latency and throughput matrix: seq len 512/1024, batch sizes 1/8/32. Will post results + logs (artifact link).
maria: Draft pricing: 1) Pay-as-you-go token rate 2) Dedicated reserved monthly commit with 20% discount min 3 months 3) Enterprise custom. Will have copy + numbers by Thu.
shannon: Support ops items: create runbook PR, training scheduled Friday, SLA escalation: 30-min page for Sev1, 4-hour for Sev2. Is that acceptable?
alex: Agree with those escalation windows. One more: docs must include 'fallback & graceful degradation' section and 'rollback criteria' for rollouts. @jasper pls include tests for fallback.
kyla: Monitoring: we'll add SLOs: availability 99.95% monthly, latency p95 thresholds as Jasper defines, and an error-rate SLO of <0.1% on request rate. Alerting: paging on SLO burn >3% in 1h.
maria: Putting this into the acceptance checklist now. Will create PR to product repo and tag folks. Expect first draft in ~6hrs.
alex: :thumbsup: We'll reconvene Thu 10AM to close the rubric. If anyone can't make it, leave comments on the PR.
